boundary: This V16 study reuses the V14/V15 sixty-window historical cohort; it is not a new holdout or a new data collection. Single Tminus1 failed necessary conditions are observational risk flags, not proof that Host had the same conditions at the later Chunnel phase. In particular Tow request != tow lock, target Warp at Tminus1 may change, and distance below100 may be altered by ordinary movement. Initiators with nonzero Tminus1 Warp are abstained entirely rather than called negatives. Numeric-code target ID aliases are abstained rather than retroactively applying the documented lowest-ID target rule. After-Host actor-at-target is observational, and return to the Tminus1 source does not prove absence of a Chunnel. No VCR Nplus1, Host mechanics promotion, or combat queue changes.
